value.signature: fn assemble_boundary < H : ClosureHeader > (input : BoundaryInput < '_ , H > , consumer : & impl BoundaryConsumer) -> BoundaryBuild

review.body: { let assessment = compare_boundary (BoundaryView { paper : Some (& input . components . paper) , local : Some (& input . components . local) , selected : input . selected , acts : input . acts , } , consumer ,) ; let components = match (& assessment . closure , & assessment . local , & assessment . paper) { (Checked :: Confirmed (closure) , Checked :: Confirmed (local) , Checked :: Confirmed (paper)) if same_premises (& closure . premises , & local . premises) && same_premises (& closure . premises , & paper . premises) => { Some (input . components) } _ => None , } ; BoundaryBuild { components , assessment } }
review.item_premise: The conditional component comparison reads public supplied context, typed values and explicit evaluator premises; it retains inability and refusal separately. No production evaluator, authenticated history or deployment authority is supplied by this operation.
